newsitem.title: USA: Circus Circus to unveil casino plans - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Circus Circus to unveil casino plans - WSJ.

text.p: Circus Circus Enterprises Inc will announce plans Tuesday for a 4,000-room Las Vegas resort that could cost as much as $1 billion, the company's biggest casino project ever, The Wall Street Journal reported Tuesday.
The resort is slated to begin construction in February with an opening targeted for the fall of 1998, the story says.
The tropical-theme complex will be built on the Las Vegas strip, the story says.
